missingness_contract.generation_failure: Retain as GENERATION_FAILURE; include in the planned denominator; prohibit complete-coverage and complete-conformance claims.
missingness_contract.missing_execution: Retain as MISSING_EXECUTION; include in the planned denominator; prohibit complete-coverage and complete-conformance claims.
missingness_contract.error_decision: Retain as ERROR; never treat as REJECT; count as a conformance failure because the primary catalog has no expected ERROR.
missingness_contract.not_applicable: Allowed only in the preregistered compatibility matrix when a structural prerequisite is false; never assigned after execution.

denominator_contract.authoritative_denominator: Every row in the frozen planned compatible-unit × profile × required-environment product, including GENERATION_FAILURE, MISSING_EXECUTION, and ERROR categories.
denominator_contract.not_applicable_source: Only the frozen pre-execution compatibility matrix; NOT_APPLICABLE rows are outside the compatible planned product and cannot be created from outcomes.
denominator_contract.exact_counts_freeze_rule: No final N may be frozen until compatibility has zero PENDING rows; the frozen matrix, profile list, and required-environment list must generate every denominator mechanically.

reporting_decision_contract.positive_abstract_rule: A proposition's positive wording may enter the abstract only when its support rule is true, its abstract_eligibility condition is true, and no falsification condition is true.
reporting_decision_contract.positive_conclusion_rule: A proposition's positive wording may enter the conclusion only when its support rule and conclusion_eligibility are true and no falsification condition is true.
reporting_decision_contract.negative_or_incomplete_rule: Every falsified, incomplete, missing, or non-evaluable proposition must use its required negative wording in the results/conclusion and cannot be silently omitted.
reporting_decision_contract.descriptive_rule: Descriptive propositions report the complete mutually exclusive category partition and exact case IDs; they never become population estimates.

propositions.title: Profile implementation conformance
propositions.applicable_units: Every preregistered compatible base × operator unit, evaluated under every profile in every required author/reproduction environment.
propositions.denominator_rule: All planned compatible unit × profile × required-environment rows; no complete-conformance proportion is reported if any planned row lacks a terminal decision.
propositions.support_rule: Every planned row is terminal and observed decision plus primary_reason exactly equals the preregistered profile expectation.
propositions.falsification_rule: At least one observed decision or primary_reason differs from its expectation, or any planned row is missing, errors, or fails generation.
propositions.permitted_positive_wording: Across every compatible case in the frozen finite corpus and every required environment, each reference implementation matched its preregistered profile-specific decision and primary reason.
propositions.required_negative_wording: List every mismatching or non-terminal row by case, base, profile, and environment; do not replace it with an aggregate pass rate.
propositions.abstract_eligibility: Only if the support rule is satisfied with no missing planned row.
propositions.conclusion_eligibility: Positive wording only if every planned row conforms; otherwise list every mismatch/non-terminal row and state that complete conformance was not observed.

propositions.title: Payload-content binding
propositions.applicable_units: Every compatible target-invalid unit created by a listed content operator while leaving authenticated manifest bytes unchanged.
propositions.denominator_rule: All preregistered compatible base × listed-operator units for each named profile, reported case by case and by operator without pooling profiles.
propositions.support_rule: P1 and P3 return REJECT for every applicable unit with the frozen digest/size precedence reason.
propositions.falsification_rule: P1 or P3 returns ACCEPT, ERROR, no terminal result, or REJECT with a primary reason different from the frozen digest/size precedence reason for any applicable unit.
propositions.permitted_positive_wording: P1 and P3 rejected every compatible unchanged-manifest payload mutation in the frozen corpus.
propositions.required_negative_wording: Identify each accepted, errored, missing, or mis-reasoned unit.
propositions.abstract_eligibility: Only if every planned applicable unit is terminal and rejected with the frozen primary reason.
propositions.conclusion_eligibility: Positive wording only if every planned applicable unit is terminal and rejected with the frozen primary reason; otherwise use the required negative wording.

propositions.title: Authenticated manifest-subject binding
propositions.applicable_units: Every compatible unit where exact manifest bytes differ from the subject authenticated by the retained attestation.
propositions.denominator_rule: All preregistered compatible units for the two named operators, separately for fixture and production-Sigstore strata.
propositions.support_rule: P2 and P3 return REJECT with SUBJECT_MISMATCH for every applicable unit.
propositions.falsification_rule: P2 or P3 returns ACCEPT, ERROR, no terminal result, or a different primary reason for any applicable unit.
propositions.permitted_positive_wording: The authenticated profiles rejected every frozen case whose exact manifest digest differed from the attested subject.
propositions.required_negative_wording: Disclose stratum and every non-rejection or reason mismatch.
forbidden_extrapolations: prevents rollback without trusted freshness state
validates payload bytes by signature alone
propositions.abstract_eligibility: Only if production and fixture strata are named separately and all planned rows are terminal.
propositions.conclusion_eligibility: Positive wording only if every planned fixture and production row rejects with SUBJECT_MISMATCH and both strata are named.

propositions.title: Signature-only content-blind ablation
propositions.applicable_units: Every compatible unchanged-manifest content mutation for P2.
propositions.denominator_rule: All compatible base × listed-operator units; report each ACCEPT as expected P2 conformance and simultaneously as a target-contract miss.
propositions.support_rule: P2 returns ACCEPT/OK for every applicable unit because its frozen contract does not inspect payload bytes.
propositions.falsification_rule: P2 does not return its preregistered ACCEPT/OK result for any applicable unit.
propositions.permitted_positive_wording: The signature-only ablation accepted the frozen payload mutations when signed manifest bytes were unchanged, demonstrating that signature validity alone did not check referenced payloads.
propositions.required_negative_wording: Any unexpected rejection or error is an implementation-conformance failure, not evidence of stronger security.
forbidden_extrapolations: all signature systems have this behavior
propositions.abstract_eligibility: Eligible as a bounded mechanism contrast only when paired with exact operator and profile names.
propositions.conclusion_eligibility: Eligible only as a finite-corpus mechanism contrast when every applicable P2 row returns its preregistered ACCEPT/OK result.

propositions.title: Checksum-only identity-blind ablation
propositions.applicable_units: Every compatible unit with coherently replaced payload and unauthenticated manifest bytes.
propositions.denominator_rule: All compatible base × coherent-substitution units for P1.
propositions.support_rule: P1 returns ACCEPT/OK for every applicable unit because all current payload digests match the substituted manifest and P1 has no identity check.
propositions.falsification_rule: P1 does not return its preregistered ACCEPT/OK result for any applicable unit.
propositions.permitted_positive_wording: The checksum-only ablation accepted every frozen coherent manifest-and-payload substitution, demonstrating the absence of author authentication in that profile.
propositions.required_negative_wording: Any unexpected rejection or error is reported as conformance failure.
forbidden_extrapolations: all substitutions evade every digest policy
propositions.abstract_eligibility: Eligible only as a finite-corpus ablation contrast.
propositions.conclusion_eligibility: Eligible only as a finite-corpus ablation contrast when every applicable P1 row returns its preregistered ACCEPT/OK result.

propositions.title: Selected provenance and authenticated-manifest policy enforcement
propositions.applicable_units: Every compatible authenticated unit containing exactly one preregistered provenance-policy violation.
propositions.denominator_rule: All compatible base × named-operator units, reported separately by violation and attestation stratum.
propositions.support_rule: P3 returns the preregistered REJECT reason for every applicable unit.
propositions.falsification_rule: P3 accepts, errors, is missing, or returns the wrong primary reason for any applicable unit.
propositions.permitted_positive_wording: P3 rejected every applicable frozen selected-profile semantic mismatch with its preregistered reason.
propositions.required_negative_wording: Identify every failed policy check; distinguish certificate/platform-derived provenance from workflow-authored manifest assertions; state that source.tar is checked as opaque exact bytes rather than as a reconstruction of the declared Git tree.
forbidden_extrapolations: predicate contents cannot be falsified by a compromised workflow
propositions.abstract_eligibility: Only if certificate and predicate trust boundaries are stated.
propositions.conclusion_eligibility: Positive wording only if every planned mismatch rejects with its preregistered reason and the certificate/workflow trust boundary is stated.

propositions.title: Clean-package acceptance
propositions.applicable_units: Every preregistered clean base compatible with a profile and environment.
propositions.denominator_rule: All clean base × profile × required-environment rows; production-Sigstore rows are reported separately.
propositions.support_rule: Every planned clean row returns ACCEPT/OK.
propositions.falsification_rule: Any clean row rejects, errors, is missing, fails generation, or returns ACCEPT with a primary reason other than OK.
propositions.permitted_positive_wording: All named clean bases were accepted by every compatible profile in the named required environments.
propositions.required_negative_wording: A single clean failure is listed prominently and makes the universal finite-corpus clean-acceptance statement false.
propositions.abstract_eligibility: Only with exact clean-base and environment denominators.
propositions.conclusion_eligibility: Positive wording only when every planned clean row is ACCEPT/OK and exact base/profile/environment denominators are stated.

propositions.title: Target-invalid acceptance enumeration
propositions.applicable_units: Every preregistered target-invalid compatible unit for each profile.
propositions.denominator_rule: For each profile and attack family, numerator is terminal ACCEPT among target-invalid units; denominator is every planned compatible target-invalid unit, with missing/ERROR/generation failures shown as separate categories rather than removed.
propositions.support_rule: Descriptive only: publish exact case lists and mutually exclusive ACCEPT, REJECT, ERROR, MISSING_EXECUTION, and GENERATION_FAILURE counts.
propositions.falsification_rule: The descriptive claim is invalid if any planned unit is omitted, categories overlap, or a finite proportion is presented as an attack-prevalence estimate.
propositions.permitted_positive_wording: Within the frozen finite corpus, profile P accepted n of N compatible target-invalid units in family F; the accepted unit IDs were [...].
propositions.required_negative_wording: State that cases were designed, not randomly sampled, and proportions do not estimate real-world prevalence or security probability.
propositions.abstract_eligibility: Only case/family-bounded totals with exact denominators and the designed-corpus limitation.
propositions.conclusion_eligibility: Always descriptive when the complete category partition and exact case IDs are reported; never eligible for a population or security-rate conclusion.

propositions.title: Cross-environment decision determinism
propositions.applicable_units: Every identical case/trust-policy byte set executed in both preregistered required environments.
propositions.denominator_rule: All planned matched environment pairs with identical case and policy hashes.
propositions.support_rule: Every matched pair has identical decision and primary_reason.
propositions.falsification_rule: Any matched pair disagrees, either member is missing/errors, or any planned pair has hash-mismatched inputs; a hash mismatch is a reproduction-input failure and bars the complete cross-environment claim.
propositions.permitted_positive_wording: Decisions and primary reasons were identical across the two named environments for every matched frozen case/policy byte pair.
propositions.required_negative_wording: List every disagreement and every input-hash mismatch; do not call same-host repetition independent reproduction.
propositions.abstract_eligibility: Only when both environments and complete matched-pair denominator are named and every planned pair is hash-identical and agrees.
propositions.conclusion_eligibility: Positive wording only when every planned pair has hash-identical inputs and identical decision/primary reason; otherwise list every disagreement/input failure.

propositions.title: Production A.M.Y GitHub/Sigstore gate
propositions.applicable_units: The frozen clean A.M.Y release manifest plus every preregistered production negative control under the exact GitHub certificate identity, source revision/ref, trusted root, Rekor, builder, and material policy.
propositions.denominator_rule: Every planned release-specific positive and negative production gate row; exactly one authenticated verification result is required per row.
propositions.support_rule: The clean A.M.Y row accepts and every named negative row rejects with its frozen reason, using the pinned verifier offline after inputs are acquired.
propositions.falsification_rule: The clean row rejects/errors/is missing or returns a primary reason other than OK; any negative row accepts/errors/is missing or rejects with a reason different from its frozen reason; more than one verification result is accepted; or any tool/policy/input digest differs.
propositions.permitted_positive_wording: The frozen A.M.Y release passed the exact preregistered GitHub/Sigstore P3 policy, while every named release-specific negative control was rejected.
propositions.required_negative_wording: State that a valid release attestation establishes the specified release identity and byte/provenance checks, not scientific truth or uncompromised workflow behavior.
forbidden_extrapolations: GitHub proves the science is true
the workflow could not have lied
propositions.abstract_eligibility: Only after RG-009 and RG-010 are complete and the exact A.M.Y release identifier is stated.
propositions.conclusion_eligibility: Positive wording only after every clean/negative production row satisfies the exact reason rule under one frozen release identity and RG-009/RG-010 are complete.

propositions.title: Independent external reproduction
propositions.applicable_units: The complete frozen benchmark executed by a qualified person or service not involved in verifier implementation, using released R0/R1 identifiers.
propositions.denominator_rule: The complete planned benchmark; partial spot checks cannot support the complete-reproduction claim.
propositions.support_rule: Before manuscript submission, a qualified external execution independently acquires the release and reproduces every matched decision and primary reason with identical input hashes.
propositions.falsification_rule: Submission is blocked if no qualified external run exists, the run is partial, inputs differ without resolution, or any matched decision/reason differs; every disagreement remains reportable evidence and cannot be retried away.
propositions.permitted_positive_wording: An independent reproducer executed the complete released benchmark and reproduced every decision and primary reason for hash-identical inputs.
propositions.required_negative_wording: If this condition is unmet, state that external reproduction has not occurred, prohibit claim C011, and keep the manuscript classified as not submission-ready.
propositions.abstract_eligibility: Never eligible without the signed/dated independent execution record.
propositions.conclusion_eligibility: Positive wording and manuscript submission require the signed/dated complete external execution record; otherwise prohibit C011 and state that reproduction has not occurred.

propositions.title: Exploratory A.M.Y and ATLAS case study
propositions.applicable_units: Only the exact audited local bytes and externally identified revisions recorded in the evidence ledger.
propositions.denominator_rule: Exact enumerated files/artifacts in each retained audit; never merge these observations into confirmatory benchmark denominators.
propositions.support_rule: Each sentence maps to an OBSERVED claim-ledger row and retained raw evidence; discrepancies and positive controls are both reported.
propositions.falsification_rule: A sentence lacks retained evidence, exceeds its snapshot scope, or is presented as preregistered/confirmatory.
propositions.permitted_positive_wording: At the identified exploratory snapshot, the audit observed [...].
propositions.required_negative_wording: Label the case study exploratory and disclose the dirty/unpublished snapshot limitations.
propositions.abstract_eligibility: May appear only as explicitly exploratory case-study context, never as a confirmatory result.
propositions.conclusion_eligibility: May appear only in a separately labeled exploratory subsection with exact snapshot scope and no confirmatory wording.
